protocol.lp: Maximise the strict winner/non-winner score margin; coefficient bounds [-1,1]; require margin > 1e-7; deterministic ascending-number tie-break
protocol.important: Feature histories exclude later draws. Coefficients use known answers, so neither this per-answer fitting nor the frozen retrospective replay is a clean prospective validation. The 20 October case trained the frozen model and is reported separately from other draws.
